O14_W5_reversal|A_full_multi_edge_p1c|co.world_note: initially edge0 dominates for both rules (f=7.920 vs 6.480; quote e.g. near +7.65558 vs +6.23484). dst1 has low demand 0.1 so deliveries shrink its deficit D1 while dst2's demand 1.2 deepens D2; the local force boundary 3.6*D1 = 1.44*D2 and the corresponding total-quote boundary are crossed in finite time (analytic: D1 contracts at rate ~1.62*D1 per unit time while D2 grows at 1.2), so the preferred destination must switch using local data only.
